traps.name: automatic_ball pitch-number offset
traps.assertion: isPitch false, details.eventType automatic_ball, no pitchNumber; Statcast emits a row for it, so pitch_number runs one ahead

traps.name: four-event intentional walk
traps.assertion: every event pitchNumber 0 and details.call.code VB; four corrected keys, one naive key

traps.name: pitch-level MJ with the play-level flag false
traps.assertion: details.hasReview true while allPlays[3].about.hasReview is false

traps.name: play-level MJ with no challenge word in the description
traps.assertion: reviewType MJ at play level, resolves to the last isPitch, and result.description does not contain 'challenged'

traps.name: overturned challenge storing the post-challenge call
traps.assertion: isOverturned true while details.call.code holds C, the call after the challenge; the original call was a ball

traps.name: MF replay record that must be filtered
traps.assertion: reviewType MF; it is a review record but not a challenge

traps.name: AAA-shaped MJ record with no player key
traps.assertion: reviewType MJ with no 'player' key; challenger_id null, challenger_role unknown, no crash
